# DAViewer 0.7.2

## 本次更新

- 搜索记录上限提升至 100 条，最近搜索优先展示，可展开查看全部。
- 搜索记录改为清晰的独立列表，标签记录带有专属图标，点击即可重新搜索或打开标签页。
- 输入标签搜索、点击推荐或热门标签都会保存记录，重复查询自动移到最前。
- 支持单条删除；清空全部搜索记录前会先确认，减少误触。

## What's New

- Keep up to 100 searches, with the most recent entries first and an option to view the full list.
- Browse clear history rows with distinct tag icons; tap an entry to search again or reopen its tag page.
- Save submitted tag searches and recommended or popular tag selections; repeated queries move to the top.
- Remove individual entries, with confirmation before clearing all search history.
